# Process

## Failure Clusters and Fixes

| Cluster | Leverage | Lever | Fix | Verify-the-Fix / Blast Radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FORMULA_LITERAL | High (9 tasks) | CONTRACT | Explicitly forbid formulas in prompt.md and guidance.md; require literal values computed in Python. | trace 37378: wrote formula `=IF(...)` -> will now compute result in Python and write literal. Safe: passing tasks already write literals. |
| TYPE_ENFORCEMENT | Med (3 tasks) | CONTRACT | Require typed values (int/float/datetime) instead of strings in prompt.md and guidance.md. | trace 416-15: wrote date as string -> will now use datetime object. Safe: passing tasks already use typed values. |
| MISSING_VALUES | Med (7 tasks) | STRUCTURE | Added verification step to check that all expected cells in answer_position are filled. | trace 227-40: missing values in output -> verification step will catch and prompt fix. Safe: additive rule. |
| VALUE_PRECISION | Low (5 tasks) | CONTRACT | Emphasized matching input precisely and avoiding unnecessary changes. | trace 38462: changed value to something higher than expected -> emphasis on minimal modification and precise matching. Safe: additive rule. |
| FAILED_TO_MODIFY | Low (1 task) | STRUCTURE | Included a "Verify Before Stopping" rule to ensure modifications actually occurred. | trace 267-18: sheet was byte-identical to input -> verification step will catch this. Safe: additive rule. |

## Subagents/Features Used
- None (diagnosed and fixed inline).

## What to Preserve
- The basic interaction loop from task_frame.md.
- The focus on `answer_position` and `output_path`.
